name: Huddle Maintenance
author: Muhammad Musab

sections.description:
Huddle Maintenance provides a professional maintenance mode experience for WordPress websites.

Temporarily replace your public website with a branded maintenance page while you update, redesign, develop, migrate, or prepare your website for launch.

Built for website owners, developers, freelancers, and agencies, Huddle Maintenance combines flexible customization with a clean and straightforward workflow.

Administrators can continue accessing the normal website while public visitors see the maintenance experience.

Features

  • Enable or disable maintenance mode instantly.
  • Administrator bypass access.
  • Custom maintenance title and visitor message.
  • Custom badge, CTA, return message, footer note, and support email.
  • Custom logo upload through the WordPress Media Library.
  • Image-only logo selection from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Custom background, card, text, and accent colors.
  • Multiple ready-made maintenance templates.
  • Live maintenance page preview.
  • Desktop, tablet, and mobile preview modes.
  • Countdown timer with preset durations.
  • Custom countdown durations in minutes, hours, or days.
  • Automatic maintenance-mode shutdown when the countdown expires.
  • Animated maintenance progress bar.
  • Adjustable progress percentage from 0% to 100%.
  • WordPress site timezone integration.
  • Optional custom region-based timezone selection.
  • Global timezone preview.
  • Lightweight visitor analytics.
  • Maintenance-page view counter.
  • Last visitor information.
  • Analytics reset functionality.
  • Complete Huddle settings reset without uninstalling the plugin.
  • Optional uninstall data cleanup.
  • Responsive public maintenance experience.
  • Guided Setup Wizard.
  • Documentation and setup guide.
  • A familiar WordPress-style administration interface with clear tabs, section headings, simple separators, and aligned settings fields.
  • Restrained white settings panels, standard WordPress controls, and responsive layouts.
  • WordPress Settings API integration.
  • WordPress Media Library integration.
  • Nonce-protected administrative actions.
  • Clean and reusable plugin architecture.

Administration Interface

Huddle Maintenance uses a straightforward interface designed to feel at home in WordPress. Settings are grouped under clear section headings, with familiar tabs, concise descriptions, horizontal dividers, and aligned labels and controls.

The administration screens use restrained colors and white settings surfaces instead of decorative gradients or animated effects. Template thumbnails and the maintenance-page preview retain their own styling so you can still compare the visitor-facing designs before applying them.

Templates

Huddle Maintenance includes ready-made visual presets that provide a quick starting point for your maintenance page.

Available template styles include:

Huddle Orange

A familiar template with a clean, high-contrast color palette.

Dark Mode

A clean dark maintenance experience with strong contrast and a modern appearance.

Business

A professional visual style designed for companies, agencies, and business websites.

Minimal

A simple and lightweight design focused on readability and essential visitor information.

Templates can be previewed before applying them.

Countdown

The built-in countdown system lets you communicate an expected maintenance duration to visitors.

Preset durations include:

  • 5 minutes
  • 15 minutes
  • 30 minutes
  • 1 hour
  • 6 hours
  • 12 hours
  • 24 hours
  • 2 days
  • 3 days
  • 7 days

Custom durations can also be configured using minutes, hours, or days.

When the countdown reaches zero, Huddle Maintenance can automatically disable maintenance mode.

Progress Bar

The animated progress bar provides visitors with a visual indication of maintenance progress.

Administrators can enable the progress bar and configure its percentage from 0% to 100%.

The progress indicator is designed to work alongside the countdown for a clearer maintenance experience.

Timezone Support

Huddle Maintenance can use the WordPress site’s configured timezone as its primary timezone.

Administrators can also select a custom region-based timezone when needed.

Timezone calculations use WordPress-compatible timezone identifiers so daylight-saving changes can be handled correctly.

The dashboard includes a timezone preview for multiple locations, including:

  • Dubai
  • London
  • New York
  • Tokyo

Analytics

Huddle Maintenance includes lightweight visitor tracking for maintenance-page activity.

The analytics dashboard provides:

  • Total maintenance-page views.
  • Current maintenance status.
  • Last visitor information.
  • Basic telemetry information.
  • Analytics reset controls.

Analytics can be reset without affecting the rest of the plugin configuration.

Setup Wizard

The Setup Wizard provides a guided overview of the most important configuration steps.

Use it to review:

  • Maintenance status.
  • Visitor title and message.
  • Logo and branding.
  • Core maintenance configuration.

Live Preview

The Live Preview system lets administrators inspect the maintenance experience before enabling it for visitors.

Preview modes include:

  • Desktop
  • Tablet
  • Mobile

Use Live Preview after changing templates, colors, logo settings, countdown configuration, progress settings, or other visitor-facing options.

Administrator Access

Administrators with the required WordPress capability can continue accessing the normal website while maintenance mode is enabled.

This allows site owners and developers to configure, test, and manage the website without being blocked by the maintenance screen.

To test the public maintenance experience, use a logged-out browser session, a private/incognito window, or another browser without the administrator session.

Settings Reset

Huddle Maintenance includes a Reset Huddle Settings feature for restoring the plugin to its default configuration without uninstalling it.

The reset operation restores:

  • Maintenance settings.
  • Visitor messaging.
  • Design colors.
  • Logo settings.
  • Countdown settings.
  • Progress settings.
  • Timezone settings.
  • Selected template.
  • Analytics data.

The reset action is protected by WordPress nonce verification and requires the appropriate administrator capability.

Data Cleanup

Huddle Maintenance provides an optional uninstall cleanup preference.

When enabled, Huddle can remove its stored plugin-specific data when the plugin is permanently deleted.

When disabled, stored configuration can remain available for future use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Huddle Maintenance from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Huddle Maintenance from the WordPress administration dashboard.
  4. Review the Setup Wizard.
  5. Configure your visitor message, branding, template, countdown, timezone, and progress settings.
  6. Use Live Preview to verify the maintenance experience.
  7. Enable maintenance mode when your website is ready.
sections.faq:
Can administrators access the website while maintenance mode is enabled?

Yes. Administrators with the required WordPress capability can continue accessing the normal website while public visitors see the maintenance page.

Can I customize the maintenance page?

Yes. You can customize messaging, branding, logo, colors, templates, countdowns, progress settings, and timezone behavior.

Does Huddle Maintenance include analytics?

Yes. Huddle Maintenance provides lightweight maintenance-page visitor statistics and telemetry.

Can I reset my settings without uninstalling the plugin?

Yes. Reset Huddle Settings restores the plugin’s default configuration without requiring an uninstall or reinstall.

Can I preview the maintenance page before enabling it?

Yes. Use the Live Preview page to inspect the maintenance experience before making it public.

Is the maintenance page responsive?

Yes. The public maintenance page adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.

Does Huddle Maintenance support countdowns?

Yes. Huddle includes preset and custom countdown durations and can automatically disable maintenance mode when the countdown reaches zero.

Does Huddle Maintenance support a progress bar?

Yes. You can enable the animated progress bar and configure its percentage from 0% to 100%.

Can I choose a custom timezone?

Yes. Huddle can use the WordPress site timezone or a custom region-based timezone.

Can Huddle delete its data when the plugin is uninstalled?

Yes. Huddle provides an optional uninstall cleanup setting that can remove stored plugin-specific data when the plugin is permanently deleted.
